formula_verified: P/B Ratio = Market Price per Share / Book Value per Share. Book Value = (Total Assets − Total Liabilities) / Outstanding Shares. P/B < 1 may indicate undervaluation (common in banking/PSU stocks). Used for asset-heavy industries.

what_is: A P/B Ratio Calculator is a digital tool that allows you to price-to-book ratio without complex manual calculations. Step 4: Enter your Industry Average P/B (e.g., ₹2). Step 5: Click 'Calculate' to see instant results. Step 6: Review the detailed breakdown and use results for financial planning. Step 7: Adjust inputs to explore different scenarios.
formula_explanation: The P/B Ratio Calculator uses: P/B Ratio = Market Price per Share / Book Value per Share. Book Value = (Total Assets − Total Liabilities) / Outstanding Shares.
